function.name: workflow_run
function.description: Execute an AI-Workflow by file path with options, state persistence, and event logging

mock.description: Execute in deterministic offline mock mode

function.name: workflow_probe
function.description: Execute deterministic system, git, and toolchain environment probing with secret redaction

sanitizeEnv.description: Whether to sanitize and redact sensitive env variables

function.name: workflow_inspect
function.description: Inspect step checkpoints, events, and artifacts of a workflow run from SQLite store

stepId.description: Optional specific step ID to inspect

includeEvents.description: Whether to include raw event stream

function.name: workflow_replay
function.description: Replay or resume a workflow run from failure with zero re-token spend

resumeFromFailed.description: Re-execute failed steps and resume execution

function.name: workflow_graph
function.description: Generate static DAG graph visualization without execution (HTML, Mermaid, or ASCII)

function.name: workflow_script_check
function.description: Compile-check a facade script (strict TS against the workflow facade, purity bans, literal rules) and return diagnostics, phases, and the site table — without executing anything

scriptPath.description: Path to the facade script (.ts) to check

cwd.description: Workspace root the script targets (default: process.cwd())

function.name: workflow_script_run
function.description: Run a facade script in the sandbox (deterministic journal; --resume replays completed nodes at zero provider calls). Returns runId, status, result value, and stats (asks/replayHits).

scriptPath.description: Path to the facade script (.ts) to run

cwd.description: Workspace root for world reads and world.run gates (default: process.cwd())

args.description: Script input, available inside the script as `args`

resumeRunId.description: Resume a prior run — completed nodes replay from the journal at zero cost

runTimeoutMs.description: Whole-run wall clock; the sandbox child tree is killed on expiry (default 600000)

budgetTotal.description: Output-token budget for the run (read-only inside the script)

function.name: workflow_run_script
function.description: Run a facade script through the sandboxed engine (journal-backed deterministic replay) and return runId, final status, per-site summaries (siteId/ordinal/status/durationMs) and stats; bounded by runTimeoutMs

scriptPath.description: Path to the facade script (.ts) to run

args.description: Script input, available inside the script as `args`

cwd.description: Workspace root for world reads and world.run gates (default: process.cwd())

runTimeoutMs.description: Whole-run wall clock; the sandbox child tree is killed on expiry (default 600000)

budgetTotal.description: Output-token budget for the run (read-only inside the script)

quiet.description: When true (the default) the response omits the capped event log; the journal keeps every event

function.name: workflow_inspect_run
function.description: Inspect a facade-script run in the journal: the dwf_runs status row, the per-site dwf_nodes table (redacted) and an evidence-ledger summary (counts and the latest entries)

dbPath.description: Journal database path (default .workflow/dwf.sqlite under the server cwd)

function.name: workflow_get_run
function.description: Fetch a facade-script run's journal short-circuit statistics — total asks, replay hits, amend hits, divergences and world.run executions (same accounting as the runner stats)

dbPath.description: Journal database path (default .workflow/dwf.sqlite under the server cwd)
